_comment: Registry for the AEO content engine: /topic-harvest, /topic-rank, /blog-brief, /blog-draft, /blog-publish, /blog-sweep, /blog-import, /content-attribution, /topic-track (.claude/commands/) and blog-actions-agent (.claude/agents/). Every Notion id, option string, weight, threshold, budget and website target lives HERE, never in a prompt. Scripts (Phase 1+): scripts/topic_harvest.py, topic_rank.py, blog_plan.py, blog_render.py, blog_sweep.py, blog_import.py, analysis/content_attribution.py. Method: methods/content-engine.md. Plan of record: methods/content-engine-plan.md (grilled with Albert 2026-10-07).
_maintenance: Notion property names and option strings are EXACT MATCH; re-verify with notion-fetch on the data_source url when a write errors on an unknown property. Weights and priors are tunable data (methods/architecture.md: a stale value here is a bug); what they MEAN is in methods/content-engine.md. cluster_performance is written ONLY by a dated decision after /content-attribution proposes it, never by a run. tests/test_content_engine_registry.py pins clusters, write_mode, status vocabularies, the actions-log vocabulary and the departments wiring; update the test in the same commit as any change it pins.

write_mode._flip: While plan_only, every command builds its plan and writes NO approval file, NO Notion row and NO pull request; scripts/blog_plan.py refuses --write-approval. Flipping to write is a dated decision recorded in the vault (05_decisions/), made after the Phase 1 dry run; tests/test_content_engine_registry.py pins the value, update it in the same commit.

clusters._comment: Albert's 8 starting clusters (2026-10-06). slug == utm_campaign value == the key here; label == the Notion select option string on Topic Backlog.Cluster, Blog Posts.Topic Cluster and Titan Content Ideas.Topic Cluster (identical option lists, verified 2026-10-07). commercial_prior and local_prior are 0-1 judgement values read by topic_rank.py; performance arrives through cluster_performance below.

cluster_rules._comment: topic_harvest.py maps a query to ONE cluster: the first matching rule wins, top to bottom; no match -> held cluster_unresolved (a person assigns it). Whole-word, case-insensitive. Order matters: cost before material so 'vinyl plank cost' lands in installation-cost.

intent_rules._comment: Query-level intent score I in [0,1]; first match wins; default Informational. Option strings: Topic Backlog.Intent uses 'Commercial'; Blog Posts.Search Intent uses the live misspelling 'Commericial' (do not correct it here without renaming it in Notion first).

scoring._comment: See methods/content-engine.md, Scoring. score = 100 * sum(w_k * term_k); effective = min(100, score * diversity). Weights MUST sum to 1.0 (tested). Accepted by Albert 2026-10-07 (Q13).

cluster_performance._comment: Written ONLY by a dated decision after /content-attribution proposes values. null/empty = no data, the prior is used alone. wins_attributed drives the ramp. Basis (Albert, 2026-10-07, Q18): Value Approx share on Titan Projects over the trailing 12 months, plus GHL lead counts including never-closed.

campaign_aliases._comment: Campaign strings seen in GHL / Make that map onto a cluster slug. The rule is campaign == slug; this table absorbs history and typos. Unknown values are reported as unmapped, never guessed.

seed_status._note: Albert 2026-10-07 (Q9/Q22): mined questions land as Proposed and a person flips them to Backlog or retires them.

topic_backlog._never_write: Topic / Question after creation (a person may rephrase it); Status Retired with reason out_of_scope or no_volume (a person's call); Status Proposed -> Backlog (a person's confirmation).

blog_posts._status_note: Target vocabulary (Albert 2026-10-07, Q15). The live property still reads Idea / Drafting / Posted until the option rename (Posted -> Published) and the three new options (Briefed, Review, Approved) are made in the Notion UI; a status option cannot be renamed through the DDL this repo uses. Until then the engine treats 'Posted' as 'Published' on read and never writes either.
blog_posts._never_write: Assignee, Payout Date, Neuron URL, Related Video (legacy relation to Blog Series collection://131596a4-505f-81d4-be5a-000b0686a105), Linked, SubTopic / SubTopic 2 on existing rows, Spokes (derived), Status Approved, and the page body once Status is Review or later.
blog_posts.body_policy: append-only below a '## Draft <date>' heading while Status is Briefed or Drafting; from Review onward the body is a person's and the run never writes it.

superseded_make_scenario.name: GSC -> Notion (Blogs)
superseded_make_scenario._note: Stays off; /topic-track replaces it in Phase 2.

titan_content_ideas._note: Topic Cluster added 2026-10-07 (blank-only write by the engine). The reverse relation 'Blog Post' is created by Notion from Blog Posts.Content Idea. Ideas never originate from Series; Series is chosen when the video is scripted from the blog (Phase 4).

titan_projects._campaign_note: Text property added 2026-10-07. Phase 3: Make 3710214 maps the GHL contact's utm_campaign custom field into it; blueprint snapshot platform-settings/blueprints/project-won-3710214.json pinned by tests/test_project_won_blueprint.py. Blank on every row until then.

ghl._comment: Verified 2026-10-07: the five UTM_* contact custom fields exist and are EMPTY on every won contact sampled; attributions[].utmCampaign is populated only on Meta-ad leads. Phase 3 is Albert's GHL work (form hidden fields / workflow) before any attribution exists.

openseo._comment: A deployment, not a repo. Albert 2026-10-07 (Q17): hosted openseo.so first; self-host path later = Cloudflare Workers + the existing Supabase Postgres. The DataForSEO key lives in that deployment, never here. The cloud session's egress proxy must allow the MCP host or harvests run from Albert's Mac.

gap_domains._comment: Albert 2026-10-07 (Q21): 'the more the merrier', within the budget cap. Speers is a gap source only; it is never linked from a post (supplier-sites.json rule).

aeo_structure._comment: From Albert's 'AEO Blog Post Structure' page (3f1596a4-505f-81f3-9899-cb75edd0d9ce, 2026-10-06). blog_plan.py --stage draft and blog_render.py validate these.

pillar_rules._phase: flip to true once the first pillar page is published

images._note: Albert 2026-10-07 (Q23): Phase 1 posts ship without images.

website._production_host_note: Vercel production domain until DNS cuts over (Albert 2026-10-07, Q14), then titanfloors.ca; the sweep rewrites Direct URL in one pass at cut-over.

policy._gate_note: Albert 2026-10-07 (Q7/Q19): one content gate, Review -> Approved in Notion by a person; the PR merge is the mechanical second gate; the weekly routine drafts two posts into Review and never opens a PR.

cadence._note: Albert 2026-10-07 (Q11). Phase 5 wires the routine; nothing is scheduled before then.
